_comment: Seasons (docs/MENU_LOBBY.md 'Time, season and weather'): picked in the main menu's Maps tab and the lobby. day_of_year: the calendar day (sun path and day length, docs/DAYNIGHT.md). temperature_offset: added to every weather target (precipitation below 0 C falls as snow). weather: the presets the random scheduler may pick in this season and their weights (0 = never); the lobby's start weather lists them too. snow / wetness: the ground at the start (0..1). Autumn leans on rain, winter on snow (every precipitation preset is cold enough to snow with the -14 C offset).
